51587313.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to C-terminal 6His tagged full length SHP2 (1 to 528 residues) (unknown origin) transfected in Escherichia coli BL21(DE3) RIPL cells assessed as dissociation constant by ITC analysis
51587313.references_previous: Hopkins, A. L.; Groom, C. R.; Alex, A. Ligand efficiency: a useful metric for lead selection. Drug Discovery Today 2004, 9 (10), 430–431.

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Isothermal Titration Calorimetry (ITC). SHP2 protein (residues 1–528) was dialyzed overnight at 4 °C against ITC buffer (50 mM HEPES/NaOH, 100 mM NaCl, 1 mM TCEP at pH 7.5), before diluting further with ITC buffer and DMSO to give a final working solution containing 5% DMSO. Compounds were dissolved in DMSO and diluted into ITC buffer to a final DMSO concentration of 5%. ITC experiments were conducted on a MicroCal Auto-ITC200, and data analyzed using Origin 7.0 software using the “One Set of Sites” model.
original_paragraph.Figure 3 caption: Figure 3. X-ray cocrystal structures of compounds bound to full-length SHP2. π–π-Stacking interactions are indicated by an orange dashed line. Hydrogen bonds are indicated by red dashed lines. Key crystallographic water molecules are shown as red spheres. Electrostatic protein surface analysis is overlaid (red is electronegative and blue is electropositive), generated using a deep neural network (DNN) model.38 (A) Fragment 1 (PDB code 8RZW bound in the phosphatase domain under the WPD-loop in the full-length construct). Residues F469 and L439 are shown from both the apo SHP2 structure (PDB code 4DGP,39 colored yellow) and fragment bound structure (colored red). (B) Fragment 2 (PDB code 8RZY) bound at Domain Interface 1. R4 from the apo SHP2 structure (PDB code 4DGP)39 is overlaid and colored in cyan. (C) Fragment 3 (PDB code 8S01) bound to the Tunnel Site. (D) Fragment 4 (PDB code 8S04) bound to the Tunnel Site.
original_paragraph.Table 1: Table 1. Chemical Structures and Binding Affinities of Fragment Screening Hits against Full-Length SHP2 Compound Binding Site Structure SHP2 ITC Kd (mM)a,b LEc 1 PTP/WPD-loop H2N-N=N-Cl >5.0 <0.35 2 Domain Interface 1 H2N-N=N-H ND - 3 Tunnel Site HN-N=C6H4-Cl 1.0 0.34 4 Tunnel Site H-N=C6H4-SO2NMe ND - aKd values were determined by ITC using full-length SHP2 protein (residues 1–528). ND = binding not detected. bData is n = 1. cLigand efficiency (LE) (kcal mol−1 per non-H atom) values were calculated according to the Hopkins formula.37 For all assay details, see Experimental Section.
